decisions.reason: Report reconstructs the corridor: A1-02 temporary removal in alpha.1, A2-01 restoration in alpha.2, net-zero change, and applies the final alpha.2 state to produceExternalEvent in src/events.ts with the quoted code. Card names are accompanied by real version history, satisfying the history requirement.

Grounded in src/events.ts: quotes `delete (event as any).ignorable`, rejects the comment's keep-the-defense claim, recommends deleting the delete line and the obsolete comment, notes the marker was never set so the delete is a no-op, and distinguishes removing the stripping code (done) from the marker policy (informational events may carry ignorable:true via the persistence seam).

Explains ignorable:true is producer-side omission-safety only for informational events old readers can omit; unknown required-on-read events must not be involved; marked events remain in the loaded log (not a filtering directive); applies this to the third-party informational producer while respecting that Session.append cannot set the marker.

Identifies that public live Session.append has no ignorable parameter (with checked d.ts evidence), explicitly rejects faking via as any casts, and defers exact integration as Unconfirmed pending verification against the plugin's real dependency; proposed checks noted without requiring execution.
